dsh-output-styles 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eb3ddf261a39a96b6c06.html
posts.en:
dsh-output-styles is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eb3ddf261a39a96b6c06.html
